recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, soft-focus portrait of a woman with long dark hair, characterized by a grainy film texture and a minimalist typographic header. The lighting is diffused, blowing out the background into a creamy white, while the subject's features remain defined but gentle.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's dark hair framing the pale face and neck
Text aligned to the top margin, spanning the width of the frame
Contrast between the sharp, dark hair and the soft, overexposed background
Balance between the left-aligned artist name and right-aligned title
coreInvariants: High-key, low-contrast lighting on the skin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait occupying the left two-thirds of the frame, angled slightly toward the viewer.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned at the upper-left intersection of thirds.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, follows the vertical line of the hair down to the shoulder, then moves upward to the horizontal text line at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of overexposed white space on the right side and behind the subject's head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Creamy white and overexposed highlights (background and skin).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep espresso and black (hair and shadows).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value; the image relies on tonal shifts rather than vibrant hues.

letterConstructionRules: Lowercase for primary name, mixed case for secondary text
characterSpecificRedesigns: Wide tracking for the primary name to create an airy feel

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over dark hair for contrast
placed over light background for contrast

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used with variations in color and tracking to distinguish roles.
graphicDevices: Horizontal alignment along a single top axis

candidateDirections.reason: Humanist qualities and clean lowercase forms.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus, high-key portrait of a woman with long dark hair and bangs. Use a 35mm film aesthetic with visible grain. The background should be overexposed white/cream. The subject should be on the left, looking slightly towards the camera.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of text at the very top. On the left, place the artist name in white, lowercase, italicized sans-serif with wide tracking. On the right, place the title in black, lowercase, italicized sans-serif with standard tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Is the text perfectly aligned along the top margin?
Is the lighting high-key with soft transitions?
Is the primary name in lowercase italics?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the display text
mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'Basia'
Do not use the specific city names 'London Warsaw New York'
Do not include the 'Compact Disc Digital Audio' logo
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text does not touch the subject's face.
Ensure the grain doesn't obscure the subject's eyes.
Verify the white text is legible against the dark hair.
Confirm the background is sufficiently blown out.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-key, grainy analog portrait with a minimalist, top-aligned italic sans-serif header to evoke a late-80s sophisticated pop aesthetic.
